# rpx

> RPX Pro — RolePlay Xtreme Professional Edition

A professional, offline-capable, open-source control center for tabletop pen & paper RPG sessions.
Built with Python + PySide6. Features a world system, soundboard, light effects, combat engine,
AI prompt generator, JSON-RPC CLI/API, and a static PWA companion for bundle viewing.

## Tools

- `python RPX_Pro_1.py` — launch the desktop application
- `python -m rpx_pro.app --cli` — start in JSON-RPC CLI mode for LLM control
- `python -m pytest -q` — run Python test suite
- `node --test web_companion/tests/library.test.mjs` — run web companion tests
- `cd web_companion && python -m http.server 8765` — serve the PWA companion locally

## Install

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python RPX_Pro_1.py
```

Requires Python 3.10+, PySide6 (Qt6). `pygame` is optional (audio fallback).

## Audience

- Tabletop RPG game masters looking for a desktop companion with AI integration
- Developers building LLM-driven RPG tools who want a JSON-RPC CLI backend
- Python/PySide6 developers studying modular Qt app architecture
- AI assistants that need to interface with the RPX Pro API programmatically

- `README.md`: full documentation (English primary, German secondary)

- `rpx_pro/cli.py`: JSON-RPC CLI entry point
- `web_companion/`: static PWA companion for bundle format
- `EXPORTFORMAT.md`: `rpx-campaign-bundle-v1` bundle specification
